2511.08094.summary: This paper proposes a new kind of graph neural network, a program that learns from data connected like a network. Here the network is scientific articles that cite each other (the Cora benchmark). It reports 82.92% accuracy at sorting the articles into topics.
2511.08094.source: Example text written by hand from the paper title and the claim quote; not model output

2601.21866.summary: This paper proposes a forecasting model that combines several specialised sub-models, called experts, to predict how a time series continues. It reports an MSE of 0.350 when predicting the next 96 steps on the ETTh1 benchmark.
2601.21866.source: Example text written by hand from the paper title and the claim quote; not model output
